verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's evidence shows an 'agent skill' that lets external AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) control Vast.ai via CLI/API — this is the reverse of the story, which asks for a built-in assistant inside Vast.ai's own product that a user can delegate tasks to. No evidence describes a native chat/assistant UI or agent embedded in the Vast.ai console itself. missing for 10: any built-in assistant UI/feature inside Vast.ai's own product, evidence of users delegating tasks to an in-product AI rather than external tools connecting to Vast.ai.
